tools.name: search_calculators
tools.description: Find calculators by name or topic (for example "mortgage", "BMI", "percent change", "kg to lb"), optionally within one category, or list every calculator in a category. Returns the slug, name, short description, category, whether calculate can run it, and the page link.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The calculator categories, with a description and how many calculators each has.

tools.name: get_calculator
tools.description: One calculator's details as its page states them: what it computes, the method or formula text, every input with its unit, default, limits and options, the results it returns, modes, supported countries for tax and currency calculators, its FAQ and the page link.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Run a calculator with the website's own formulas and return its results, the inputs used (omitted inputs take their default, listed in defaults_applied), any table it builds (for example an amortization schedule) and the page link. Input keys and option values come from get_calculator. Calls count t
